name: code-server 4 VS Code in Your Browser
description: VS Code in your browser with a password, saved home, Node.js and Python.

PASSWORD.description: Login password for code-server, generated at deploy (copy it from this variable). Min 8 characters; otherwise the login stays locked.

PORT.description: Port code-server listens on. The public domain and the healthcheck use it.

TZ.description: Time zone of the terminal and tools, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

GIT_REPO.description: Optional. Git URL cloned into ~/project on the first start (public, or with a token in the URL).

EXTENSIONS.description: Optional. Open VSX extension ids installed at start, space-separated, e.g. 'ms-python.python esbenp.prettier-vscode'.

APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional. Debian packages (space-separated) reinstalled in the background after every redeploy, e.g. 'postgresql-client'.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so open files are saved.
